newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sees 15.4 mln tonnes 1996/97 beet sugar output.
newsitem.headline: EU sees 15.4 mln tonnes 1996/97 beet sugar output.

text.p: European Union beet sugar output is expected to total 15.42 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July/June), compared with a July forecast of 15.71 million and last year's production of 15.64 million, according to an official forecast.
The forecast, distributed to the EU sugar management committee on Wednesday, was based on an average yield of 7.65 tonnes per hectare and an area of 2.01 million ha, a trade source said.
"It is likely that the final results, when they are in, will show greater variation than so far estimated. Only Denmark and Spain are showing significant rises at this stage," the source said.
A Commission official said that the crop forecasts were provisional and likely to change once the harvest was completed.
Sowings were slightly below the 2.09 million ha in 1995/96.
